title: Mokpo VTS, Mokpo port area (CH 14)
authority: Korea Coast Guard (해양경찰청), Mokpo VTS Centre (목포광역 해상교통관제센터)
applies_to: Ships under VTS (관제대상선박): ships on international voyages; ships of 300 GT and over (not domestic fishing vessels); dangerous cargo ships; passenger ships; and some ships under 300 GT fitted with AIS (tugs, pilot boats, bunker and water boats, work vessels, government vessels). A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
applies_quote: 법 제2조제3호 관제대상선박: 가. 국제항해에 취항하는 선박 나. 총톤수 300톤 이상의 선박. 다만, 「어선법」 제2조제1호에 따른 어선 중 국내항 사이만을 항행하는 내항어선은 제외한다. 다. 「해상교통안전법」 제2조제4호에 따른 위험화물운반선 ... 고시 제5조: 1. 법 제2조제3호가목부터 다목까지의 선박 2. 「해운법」 제2조제1호의2에 따른 여객선 3. 총톤수 300톤 미만의 선박 중 「선박설비기준」 제108조의5에 따른 자동식별장치를 설치한 다음 각 목의 선박 ...

when.text: Navigation report when entering the VTS area: 1) ship's name 2) position 3) destination 4) air draught (only ships that will pass a listed bridge or power line and are as high as or higher than its limit) 5) other items needed for traffic safety. (선박교통관제구역에 들어올 때: 1) 선박명 2) 선박의 위치 3) 목적지 4) 수면상 최고 높이 ... 7) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

10 minutes before getting under way (from a berth or anchorage inside the area): 1) ship's name 2) position and planned time of sailing 3) destination 4) air draught (only if passing a listed bridge or line at or above its limit) 5) other items. (항행을 시작하기 10분 전: 1) 선박명 2) 선박의 위치, 항행예정 시각 3) 목적지 4) 수면상 최고 높이 ...)
When starting to navigate: 1) ship's name 2) call sign 3) time navigation started 4) other items. (항행을 시작할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 호출부호 3) 항행 시작 시각 4) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

Anchoring or mooring report when anchoring or mooring: 1) ship's name 2) call sign 3) time and position of anchoring or mooring 4) other items. (정박 또는 계류할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 호출부호 3) 정박 또는 계류 시각ㆍ위치 4) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

Pilot boarding: ship's name, pilot's name or code, time and place of boarding, destination, air draught, other items. Pilot leaving: ship's name, time and place. The master may let the pilot make these calls. (도선사가 승선할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 도선사 성명 또는 약호 3) 승선 시각ㆍ장소 4) 목적지 5) 수면상 최고 높이 ... 도선사가 하선할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 하선 시각ㆍ장소)
When entering an offshore wind farm (one in commercial operation): ship's name, position, other items. (해상풍력발전단지에 들어올 때: 1) 선박명 2) 선박의 위치 3) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

At once, if the ship sees an obstruction in a fairway or a marine accident that does or may endanger traffic in the area (Act art. 14(5)). (선박교통관제구역 내의 항로상의 장애물이나 해양사고 발생 등으로 선박교통의 안전을 해치거나 해칠 우려가 있다고 인지한 경우에는 지체 없이 이를 선박교통관제관서에 신고하여야 한다.)

how.note: VTS working channel for this area (Annex 1)
distress, urgency and safety; DSC CH 70

lines.text: Ship's position (선박의 위치); on departure also the planned time of sailing
Air draught (수면상 최고 높이), only when passing a listed bridge or power line and the ship is as high as or higher than the limit
Call sign (호출부호) and time, in the 'starting to navigate' and anchoring/mooring reports
Other items needed for traffic safety (그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

format_note: Voice reports on the VHF working channel of the area. English may be used (Decree art. 10(1)). The VTS may let the ship leave out items it can already see on AIS (Annex 2 note 3; notice art. 7(3) with prior agreement). No exit report is listed in the rules; keep watch on the working channel and CH 16 while in the area.
area_quote: ○ 다음 각 기점을 순차적으로 연결한 선 안의 해역(목포항 및 인근 해역) 01. 북위 34도 48분 51초, 동경 126도 22분 12초 02. 북위 34도 48분 48초, 동경 126도 21분 34초(정주도) ... 46. 북위 34도 48분 51초, 동경 126도 22분 12초

verification: Coordinates parsed from the Annex 1 PDF of notice 2026-10 (law.go.kr download), point numbers checked to run 1 to n without gaps. NOT cross-checked with the KCG web page (that page does not carry the area as text).  Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.  inside_hint is the point farthest from the boundary, computed from the polygon; it was not checked against a chart, so it may fall on an island.
notes: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Mokpo VTS centre has three sub-areas: Mokpo port and nearby waters (CH 14, Mokpo VTS), Dochodo to Eobuldo (CH 67, Jindo VTS), Anmado to Dochodo (CH 13, Shinan VTS). Position reporting lines (Annex 2): ships using the Mokpo-gu / Siahae / Jeongdeunghae routes report when crossing the south line, latitude 34 30 42N (north end of Jeodo), northbound, or the north line, latitude 34 37 25N (east end of Majindo), southbound: ship's name, position, and whether the ship uses the deep-water route or the Mokpo-gu/Siahae/Jeongdeunghae route. Southbound ships using the Myeongnyang Sudo route may skip it. Air draught report limits: Mokpo Bridge (목포대교) 45 m, Jindo Bridge (진도대교) 15 m (Annex 2). KCG page: watch CH 14, CH 67, CH 13 and CH 16; speed limits in Mokpo-gu (20 kn) and near Jangjwado (12 kn); Mokpo inner harbour 5 kn; submarine cable between Hwawon peninsula and Anjwado. Jindo Coastal page: follow the traffic separation schemes and the oil tanker prohibited area rules. Quick record (user asked for speed): area, channel, call name and report rules from the notice; phone from the KCG page; not polished.
